fusions.name: Spat Venom
fusions.desc: Spits venom that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Torpor Breath
fusions.desc: Breathes a cone of cold that deals 12 damage to everything caught in it and stuns it for 0.8 seconds. Each hit has a 70% chance of leaving the target [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sunning Rock
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Midday Vigour
fusions.desc: In daylight, you deal 12% more damage.
